---
title: "Cumulative Unique Users by Application"
description: "Distinct users per application this month or this calendar year."
---

The number of distinct users observed for each application over a chosen
reporting window: this month or this calendar year.

The cumulative unique-user columns increase or remain stable over time. This
metric is closer to "how many distinct people have used the application in this
window" than the daily unique user metrics.

## Calculation

Take the latest value of the cumulative unique-user column over
the selected window, grouped by application. The window is chosen by *which
column* you read (see [the note on reporting timespans](../notes.qmd#metrics-can-be-reported-over-different-timespans)):

- `mtd_unique_users` for month-to-date
- `ytd_unique_users` for year-to-date

The `WHERE CAST(from_date AS DATE) BETWEEN ...` bounds set the "as of" reporting date; the
most recent row in the window holds the current cumulative total.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Example queries"}

::: {.panel-tabset}

## SQL

Month-to-date:

```sql
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        application_name,
        from_date,
        mtd_unique_users,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY application_name
            ORDER BY from_date DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM ibm_verify_events_transformed.events_app_login_counts
    WHERE CAST(from_date AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-08'
    -- to exclude internal applications from adoption reporting, uncomment:
    -- AND application_name NOT IN (
    --     SELECT al.alias
    --     FROM   rp.alias al
    --     JOIN   rp.service s ON al.rp_id = s.rp_id
    --     WHERE  s.is_internal
    -- )
)

SELECT
    application_name,
    mtd_unique_users
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY mtd_unique_users DESC;
```

Year-to-date:

```sql
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT
        application_name,
        from_date,
        ytd_unique_users,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY application_name
            ORDER BY from_date DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM ibm_verify_events_transformed.events_app_login_counts
    WHERE CAST(from_date AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-06-08'
    -- to exclude internal applications from adoption reporting, uncomment:
    -- AND application_name NOT IN (
    --     SELECT al.alias
    --     FROM   rp.alias al
    --     JOIN   rp.service s ON al.rp_id = s.rp_id
    --     WHERE  s.is_internal
    -- )
)

SELECT
    application_name,
    ytd_unique_users
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY ytd_unique_users DESC;
```

## R

Month-to-date:

```r
tbl(con, in_schema("ibm_verify_events_transformed", "events_app_login_counts")) |>
  filter(
    as.Date(from_date) >= as.Date("2026-06-01"),
    as.Date(from_date) <= as.Date("2026-06-08")
  ) |>
  # to exclude internal applications from adoption reporting, uncomment:
  # anti_join(
  #   tbl(con, in_schema("rp", "alias")) |>
  #     inner_join(tbl(con, in_schema("rp", "service")), by = "rp_id") |>
  #     filter(is_internal) |>
  #     select(application_name = alias),
  #   by = "application_name"
  # ) |>
  group_by(application_name) |>
  slice_max(
    from_date,
    n = 1,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) |>
  select(
    application_name,
    mtd_unique_users
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(mtd_unique_users))
```

Year-to-date:

```r
tbl(con, in_schema("ibm_verify_events_transformed", "events_app_login_counts")) |>
  filter(
    as.Date(from_date) >= as.Date("2026-01-01"),
    as.Date(from_date) <= as.Date("2026-06-08")
  ) |>
  # to exclude internal applications from adoption reporting, uncomment:
  # anti_join(
  #   tbl(con, in_schema("rp", "alias")) |>
  #     inner_join(tbl(con, in_schema("rp", "service")), by = "rp_id") |>
  #     filter(is_internal) |>
  #     select(application_name = alias),
  #   by = "application_name"
  # ) |>
  group_by(application_name) |>
  slice_max(
    from_date,
    n = 1,
    with_ties = FALSE
  ) |>
  select(
    application_name,
    ytd_unique_users
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(ytd_unique_users))
```

:::

:::

## Interpretation notes

Each column resets on its own cadence: `mtd_unique_users`
resets at the start of each month and `ytd_unique_users` at the start of each
calendar year. Do not sum these columns across rows; they are already cumulative.

## Alternative names

- month-to-date unique users by application
- year-to-date unique users by application
- distinct user reach per application
- total unique people reached per application
